highlights: I am proud to share I have joined NetBrain Technologies Inc. as CMO. NetBrain has spent 20 years helping enterprises prevent outages and automate the management of the world's most complex networks. Some of the largest enterprises rely on them daily—a position earned through technical depth and relentless focus on customer success. Now comes the next evolution: Agentic NetOps—bringing autonomous, AI-driven operations to enterprise infrastructure. Two decades of building network intelligence into the platform, now ready to act. I'm proud to join a team led by Bernadette Nixon—reunited from our days at CA Technologies. I've watched Bernadette build an impressive track record as CEO since and love her passion and customer focus. Founder LP Gao, who built an amazing business, provides us leadership and vision on the board as the company enters its next chapter. My first week was at the company kickoff, where I met product, engineering, and customer teams with deep expertise in enterprise networking—many over a decade at NetBrain. The pride they take in what they've built is evident. So is the passion to serve customers. A big thank you to everyone for the warm welcome. I'm energized and ready to get to work. If you're in network automation, infrastructure, or just curious about the space—let's connect.
